description: US Federal Register documents (final rules, proposed rules, notices, presidential documents) matching a full-text query, newest first, with optional filters by agency, document type and publication date. Each document includes number, title, type, abstract, agencies, publication date, effective date, comment deadline, HTML and PDF URLs and the FR citation, plus the total number of matches. Source: Federal Register API. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402).

agency.description: Agency slug as used on federalregister.gov/agencies, lowercase with hyphens, e.g. environmental-protection-agency, securities-and-exchange-commission, health-and-human-services-department; comma-separated for several (optional)

type.description: RULE (final rule), PRORULE (proposed rule), NOTICE or PRESDOCU; comma-separated for several (optional)
